title: Yadda inganta amfanin gona ke aiki: kwayoyin halitta, pollination da iri iri
course_title: Haɓakar Noma da Inganta amfanin gona

say: Yadda inganta amfanin gona ke aiki: kwayoyin halitta, pollination da iri iri.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na 1 na Haɓakar Noma da Inganta amfanin gona.
Abin da kuke gani a shuka ya fito ne daga kwayoyin halittarsa da muhallinsa: kasa, ruwan sama, ciyawa, kwari da taki.

say: Sashin kwayoyin halitta ne kawai ake yadawa a cikin iri.

say: Kwayoyin halitta suna zuwa bi-biyu, ɗaya daga kowane iyaye. Misali, Ngozi a jihar Enugu ta tsallaka wata masara mai ruwan dorawa mai tsantsar farin masara. Yellow shine rinjaye, ma'ana yana ɓoye fari.

panel.heading: Gicciyen Ngozi: tsarin 3 zuwa 1
items: Tsantsar rawaya YY x tsantsar farin yy
F1: duk Yy, duk rawaya
F1 tsire-tsire suna pollinate juna
F2: YAYA, DA, DA, DA
Kwayoyin 400: kusan rawaya 300, fari 100

say: Ingantattun nau'in pollinated iri-iri, ko OPV, ya fito daga cibiyar bincike. Kuna iya ajiye iri nasa na wasu yanayi. Ya dogara da kuɗin ku, abubuwan shigar ku da kasuwa.

say: Misali Halima tana noman masara hekta 1 kusa da Zariya. Ta kwatanta matasan tare da ingantaccen OPV, duka ana shuka su a kilo 20 a kowace kadada.

card.title: Irin Halima yakai sama da shekaru uku

say: Haɓakar iri a kusan naira 5,000 akan kowace kilogiram na naira 100,000 a kowace kakar, don haka naira 300,000 a cikin yanayi uku.

card.title: Irin Halima yakai sama da shekaru uku

say: Samfurin OPV a kusan naira 2,500 akan kowace kilogiram yana biyan naira 50,000 a kakar wasa ta 1.

card.title: Irin Halima yakai sama da shekaru uku

say: Sannan ta ajiye kilo 20 na hatsin kanta a kowace kakar, kimanin Naira 14,000, don haka Naira 28,000 na kaka biyu.

card.title: Irin Halima yakai sama da shekaru uku

say: Kafin kakar wasa, rubuta burin ku da halayen dole ne ku kasance da su. Zabi ko da ƙasa mai ƙasa da gangara iri ɗaya.
A ware tsabar kuɗi don iri da takin da yake buƙata. Shirya littafin rubutu ko takarda, kuma ku san wakilin fadada ADP na ku.

panel.heading: Shirya don gwada sabon iri?
items: Buri ɗaya bayyananne an rubuta
Halayen dole ne aka jera
Ko da ƙasar gwaji da aka zaɓa
Iri da kasafin shigar da aka keɓe a gefe
An shirya littafin rubutu ko takarda
An gano lambar sadarwar tsawaita

say: Don tunawa. Kwayoyin halitta kawai ke wucewa a cikin iri. Uniform F1 yana rarrabuwa a cikin ƙarni na gaba, don haka siyan nau'in nau'in nau'in iri a kowane kakar. Masara na ketare cikin sauƙi, don haka tana buƙatar ware. Kuma fara daga burin da aka rubuta, ba jakar iri mai launi ba.

say: Yanzu taswirar pollination ga kowane amfanin gona da kuka shuka. Bincika farashin matasan da OPV tare da dillalan agro-dila ɗaya kuma sake gyara jimlar lokutan uku. Sannan rubuta bayanin martaba iri-iri tare da ma'auni masu nauyi.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Taswirar pollination don amfanin gonanku
Bincika farashin iri tare da dillalin agro
Rubuta bayanin martaba iri-iri da maki
